resources.string: Rumo only watches web browsers (Chrome, Brave, Firefox…): it reads the website address so it can count time per website and show the block or pause screen when a limit, focus session or schedule applies. It does not observe any other app, including banking apps. Nothing is sent anywhere: all data stays on this phone. Rumo never reads what you type, your messages or passwords.
